sort_order.description: Nullable compatibility projection constrained to the exact cross-language JSON integer range 0..9007199254740991; category.list orders null after every integer.

category_id.description: Nullable opaque weak reference. Event detail preserves this value even when the related Category is missing or soft-deleted and the category projection is null.

date.description: Original user-local date. A non-null recurrence_id means this date supplies the yearly month/day anchor.

recurrence_id.description: Null for a one-time Anniversary. A non-null value references one active, exclusively owned Anniversary recurrence with frequency=yearly and interval=1.
